content.user_title: Evaluate Data Asset ABS and REITs Structures
content.value_statement: Data asset financing requires clear rights, predictable cash flows, and credible risk controls. This skill structures eligibility reviews, stress tests, enhancement plans, and issuance workflows.
actual_capabilities: Checks five eligibility conditions for data asset ABS financing.
Builds baseline and stressed cash flow assessment frameworks.
Designs SPV, tranche, payment waterfall, and maturity structures.
Compares internal and external credit enhancement measures.
Outlines intermediary coordination, filing, issuance, and servicing steps.
Produces checklists for reports, disclosures, and quality review.
limitations: It does not replace licensed legal, audit, rating, underwriting, or regulatory advice.
It cannot verify ownership, contracts, cash flows, or current regulatory acceptance without supplied evidence.
Market thresholds and policy references require confirmation for the relevant jurisdiction and date.
It provides analytical drafts, not approvals, ratings, investment recommendations, or guaranteed financing outcomes.

use_cases.title: Screen a Financing Candidate
use_cases.description: Assess cash flow stability, collection, ownership, duration, and scale before committing resources to an ABS project.

use_cases.title: Develop a Transaction Concept
use_cases.description: Draft an SPV, tranche, waterfall, stress test, and credit enhancement concept for specialist review.

use_cases.title: Review Issuance Readiness
use_cases.description: Map required intermediaries, deliverables, controls, disclosures, and unresolved evidence before formal submission.

prompt_templates.title: Initial Eligibility Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this data asset for ABS eligibility using the five conditions. List missing evidence and recommend the next step.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a structured screening review.

prompt_templates.title: Cash Flow Stress Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these historical cash flows under baseline, 20 percent decline, and 50 percent decline scenarios. Calculate coverage and identify sensitivities.
prompt_templates.scenario: An analyst has revenue and debt-service assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Transaction Structure Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an illustrative SPV, tranche structure, payment waterfall, maturity profile, and internal and external credit enhancement plan for this asset pool.
prompt_templates.scenario: An adviser needs a transaction concept for review.

prompt_templates.title: Issuance Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this proposed data asset ABS against eligibility, evidence, stress, structure, enhancement, intermediary, disclosure, filing, and servicing requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: A project team needs an advanced gap analysis.

output_examples.input: Annual contracted revenue is 60 million yuan, but one customer contributes 72 percent. Is the pool suitable for ABS?
output_examples.output: Preliminary status: conditional. Scale may be sufficient, but customer concentration weakens predictability. Obtain contract, renewal, collection, ownership, and transfer evidence before structuring.

output_examples.input: Baseline cash flow is 18 million yuan and annual debt service is 14 million yuan. Test a 20 percent decline.
output_examples.output: Baseline coverage is 1.29 times. A 20 percent decline produces 14.4 million yuan and 1.03 times coverage, leaving limited protection.

output_examples.input: Suggest credit enhancement for a pool with volatile subscription revenue.
output: Use senior and subordinated tranches with meaningful first-loss retention.
Set overcollateralization and reserve levels from stressed cash flows.
Evaluate a qualified guarantee or shortfall commitment.
Document triggers, replenishment rules, and enforcement terms.

best_practices: Provide dated source documents for ownership, transferability, contracts, collections, and historical cash flows.
State assumptions, calculation periods, and data gaps beside every conclusion.
Confirm all legal, accounting, rating, and regulatory conclusions with qualified local professionals.
anti_patterns: Do not treat an asset valuation as proof of predictable securitizable cash flow.
Do not present illustrative thresholds or structures as regulatory approval.
Do not hide concentration, transfer restrictions, weak collections, or adverse stress results.

faq.question: What evidence is needed for an eligibility review?
faq.answer: Provide ownership records, transfer terms, customer contracts, collection history, revenue data, forecasts, and proposed financing terms.

faq.question: Can an asset without current cash flow support ABS?
faq.answer: Generally no. The skill treats stable, attributable, and collectible cash flow as a core requirement.

faq.question: Does the skill provide legal or investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured analysis and drafts that qualified advisers and licensed institutions must review.

faq.question: Can it calculate coverage ratios?
faq.answer: Yes, when you provide cash flow and debt-service assumptions with clear periods and units.

faq.question: Does it distinguish ABS from REITs?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains debt-style cash flow securitization and equity-style asset participation, while noting limited data asset REITs precedent.

faq.question: Are the policy references always current?
faq.answer: No. Confirm every rule, threshold, filing route, and market practice for the jurisdiction and transaction date.
